title: New diagnostic pathway in primary diagnosis of clinically significant prostate cancer adding PSMA-PET to mpMRI
official: New diagnostic pathway in primary diagnosis of clinically significant prostate cancer adding PSMA-PET to mpMRI
summary: Main objective: To assess the additional value of [68Ga]Ga-PSMA-11 PET/CT to reliably detect clinically significant prostate cancer (csPCa).

interventions.name: Locametz 25 micrograms kit for radiopharmaceutical preparation

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Patient is male and aged ≥18 years old
2. Clinical suspicion of PCa: PSA 3 – 20 ng/ml
3. mpMRI showing PI-RADS 4-5 (Version 2.1) (Not older than 3 months prior to study enrollment)
4. Planned histologic confirmation
5. Signed and dated written informed consent
Exclusion criteria:
1. Men with prior diagnosed prostate cancer
2. Prior prostate biopsy
3. Known hypersensitivity to [68Ga]Ga-PSMA-11 or its components
4. Acute infection within 8 weeks prior to enrollment (e.g. urinary tract infection, prostatitis, gastroenteritis)
5. History of chronic prostatitis
6. Administration of any kind of PET tracer within a period corresponding to 8 half-lives of the respective radionuclide
7. Any other investigational medicinal product administered within 30 days prior and up until completion of Visit 6
8. Inability to lie flat, remain still, or tolerate a PET scan
